Package: MCC_DISPATCH

Name

MCC_DISPATCH

Comment

Results from the Marginal Constraint Cost (MCC) re-run of the dispatch process. The MCC forms part of the part of the AER‟s “Electricity transmission network service providers Service target performance incentive Scheme”


List of tables

Name

Comment

MCC_CASESOLUTION

Top level table for each MCC dispatch rerun process. Note there will be one record for each dispatch interval

MCC_CONSTRAINTSOLUTION

Constraint solution data from the MCC dispatch rerun process. Note only constraints with a non-zero marginal value are published.
